title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 401 McElroy Drive in Oxford, Mississippi, as the "Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 401 McElroy Drive in Oxford, Mississippi, as the "Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names the Oxford, Mississippi post office building at 401 McElroy Drive after Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building in Oxford, Mississippi, as the Army First Lieutenant Donald C. Carwile Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2016.
